presentation.manual_preparation: On first Play, choose your own USA PlayStation Alien Resurrection disc image (SLUS-00633). This separate managed copy uses its saves folder for settings, memory cards, quick save and logs. Portcove also preserves runtime-folder shot_*.png screenshots and vram_*.png captures. Original disc files, external-copy profiles, custom save paths and custom debug destinations stay external. Make a memory-card save in game BEFORE updating, switching runtime versions or rolling back. Quick saves are version-specific and have one slot; retain the old runtime if your latest progress exists only in its quick save. Runtime rollback carries current declared data, not earlier saves or guaranteed older-version compatibility. Linux needs glibc 2.35+ and a working Vulkan environment; other platforms need separate review.
